all.spearman_median_note: Tie-broken: train._rank assigned ordinal ranks without averaging ties, which on these 74-95%-zero profiles measures position rather than signal (sign wrong on ~75% of transcripts). Fixed in train._rank 2026-08-30; this stored value predates the fix and must not be read as a rank correlation. See docs/xspecies_paper/METHODS.md section 6.2.
